2607.19674.title: FedLSG: LLM-Enhanced Semantic Calibration for Federated Graph Backdoor Defense
2607.19674.paper_summary: Federated Graph Neural Networks (FedGNNs) are highly vulnerable to backdoor poisoning, yet existing defenses typically rely on rule-based approaches that lack semantic understanding, making them vulnerable to stealthy triggers and harmful to benign structures. To solve this, we present FedLSG, the first framework that integrates large language models (LLMs) into federated graph backdoor defense. FedLSG introduces a graph and behavior to text grounding scheme that transforms local graph structures and client update behaviors into semantically rich natural language representations. The framework further adopts a lightweight student-teacher architecture. On the server side, a full scale LLM serves as a teacher, providing global contextual guidance and evaluating client updates during aggregation to identify potentially malicious participants. On the client side, a LoRA-based student is maintained to perform semantic reasoning, to suppress the influence of edges associated with backdoor triggers. By enabling semantic interpretation of both graph patterns and client behaviors, the framework adaptively incorporates rule-based signals into message passing and client aggregation for defense. Experiments demonstrate that FedLSG significantly improves resistance to backdoor attacks without compromising graph integrity.
2607.19674.paper_summary_zh: 聯邦圖神經網絡（FedGNNs）對後門攻擊高度脆弱，但現有的防禦通常依賴於缺乏語義理解的基於規則的方法，這使它們易受隱蔽觸發器的影響，並對良性結構造成損害。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了FedLSG，這是第一個將大型語言模型（LLMs）整合到聯邦圖後門防禦中的框架。FedLSG引入了一種圖形和行為到文本的基礎方案，將本地圖結構和客戶端更新行為轉換為語義豐富的自然語言表示。該框架進一步採用輕量級的學生-教師架構。在伺服器端，一個全規模的LLM作為教師，提供全球上下文指導並在聚合過程中評估客戶端更新，以識別潛在的惡意參與者。在客戶端，一個基於LoRA的學生被維護以進行語義推理，抑制與後門觸發器相關的邊的影響。通過啟用圖模式和客戶端行為的語義解釋，該框架自適應地將基於規則的信號納入消息傳遞和客戶端聚合以進行防禦。實驗表明，FedLSG顯著提高了對後門攻擊的抵抗力，而不損害圖的完整性。
